description: Use this when someone quotes or pastes a Vinted seller's or buyer's message, or a Vinted listing's description, and asks if it's safe, legit, a scam, or what the red flags are (e.g. 'A Vinted seller wrote: "pay me on WhatsApp and I'll ship today". Is this a scam?', 'this listing says "iCloud locked, sold as is", should I buy?'). Returns each warning sign in the quoted words, found by the same text checks Pouncio's buying bots run before paying: paying or talking outside Vinted, refusing Vinted's item verification, an iCloud or Google lock, a named fault, or only the box for sale. Works in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Dutch and Portuguese. Do not use when nothing is quoted (general scam advice), for prices (use check_resale_price), or for a listing link without its text (use check_listing_deal).

text.description: The listing description or message, as pasted.
text.title: Text
